Overnight Country Loaf.paprikarecipe.directions:
Mix the levain ingredients (whole wheat flour, water, ripe starter) and leave at room temperature for 10 hours.
Mix the bread flour, whole wheat flour and water and rest for 40 minutes.
Add the levain and fine salt, then fold every 30 minutes for 3 hours.
Shape, retard overnight, and bake at 475F in a covered pot for 20 minutes, then 20 uncovered.
Overnight Country Loaf.paprikarecipe.ingredients:
28g (1 oz) whole wheat flour
28g (2 tablespoons) water
6g (1 teaspoon) ripe starter
450g (1 lb) bread flour
50g (1/3 cup) whole wheat flour
360g (1 1/2 cups) water
10g (2 teaspoons) fine salt
Overnight Country Loaf.paprikarecipe.name: Overnight Country Loaf

Sandwich Loaf.paprikarecipe.directions:
Mix everything to a smooth dough and knead for 8 minutes.
Prove until doubled, shape into a pan loaf, and prove again.
Bake at 400F for 35 minutes.
Sandwich Loaf.paprikarecipe.ingredients:
Bread flour: 500g (4 cups)
Water: 325g (1 1/3 cups)
Salt: 10g (1 3/4 tsp)
Instant yeast: 7g (2 1/4 tsp)
Butter: 30g (2 tbsp)
Sandwich Loaf.paprikarecipe.name: Sandwich Loaf
